subject: SIG questionnaire: key revocation, transport logs, and emergency rotation evidence
messages:
From: Mike Chen <mike.chen@clearpay.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG follow-up — key revocation & transport evidence

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking the SIG with us last week. As we finish our internal review, we have a short list of evidentiary items we need around key revocation and transport handling for tenant-managed keys:

1) A sampling of revocation events (last 12 months) showing the revoke/disable workflow, operator id, and post-revocation key state.
2) Transport log excerpts demonstrating cross-region wrapped-key transfers (timestamps, source/destination hosts, and envelope IDs).
3) Your emergency rotation playbook and a signed artifact proving a past emergency rotation occurred (redaction OK).

Can you confirm if these are available and the expected delivery ETA? We can accept a Drive folder or secure SFTP.

Also please include any operator access matrix and the HSM wrap certificate used for envelope wrapping.

Best,
Mike
Security Manager, ClearPay
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Chen <mike.chen@clearpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — key revocation & transport evidence

Mike —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide all three items. Proposed plan and ETA below:

- Revocation samples (anonymized): we will produce a CSV export with event ids, UTC timestamps, operator principal (redacted to role), and final key state. ETA: 2028-04-25 EOD.
- Transport logs (wrapped-key transfers): filtered log excerpts with envelope IDs and transfer hashes. ETA: 2028-04-26.
- Emergency rotation playbook + signed artifact: we'll deliver the playbook PDF and a redacted ledger proof of a past emergency rotation (signed by on-call SRE). ETA: 2028-04-26.

I'll loop in Karthik and Irene to attach the artifacts and confirm sanitized fields for sharing. We can upload to the Drive folder you prefer (we see you listed secure SFTP as an option — which do you prefer?).

Note: we will also include the operator access matrix and the HSM wrap certificate (PEM, signed).

-rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@clearpay.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-23T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — key revocation & transport evidence

Mike / team —

Per Rachel, attaching the index of artifacts we will deliver and a short explanation of each item:

1) clearpay_evidence_index.csv (attached) — top-level manifest that maps sample files to SIG control IDs and redaction notes.
2) kms-operator-access-matrix.csv (attached) — role-based operator matrix; we redact individual PII and show role IDs and SSH key fingerprints.
3) revocation-log-samples.csv (attached) — 12-month sample of revocation events. Fields: event_id, utc_ts, tenant_id (hashed), operator_role, reason_code, final_state.
4) signed-wrap-cer.pem (attached) — HSM certificate used for envelope wrapping (public cert only).
5) transport-logs/ — Drive folder with filtered transfer log excerpts and envelope mapping.
6) emergency-rotation-playbook.pdf — PDF with steps, Slack playbook channel, and post-incident ledger sample (redacted); we will include a signed ledger extract as proof of a prior rotation.

Security notes: all artifacts are sanitized to remove tenant identifiers and operator PII; where needed we substitute role tokens (e.g., SRE-OnCall-1). The transport logs will include IP blocks masked to /24 and will preserve timestamps and envelope IDs for traceability.

ETA: upload to shared Drive link by 2028-04-26 16:00 PDT. If you require SFTP instead, flag and we'll push there.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Product Security — Redwood Inference
From: Mike Chen <mike.chen@clearpay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-24T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — key revocation & transport evidence

Thanks Karthik — that plan looks good. A couple quick clarifications before you upload:

- For the revocation samples: can you include a short README listing what was redacted and the hashing/salting method used for tenant_id? We need to ensure our audit can map a sample back to the tenant without revealing PII.
- For the signed ledger extract: can the signature be accompanied by the signing key fingerprint and the SRE on-call role that signed it?

Drive is preferred by default. If the artifacts are large we can accept an SFTP drop; otherwise Drive is fine.

-Mike
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Chen <mike.chen@clearpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-26T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — key revocation & transport evidence

Mike —

All artifacts uploaded to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefGH_clearpay_evidence

What we included (index and direct attachments):
- clearpay_evidence_index.csv (maps files to SIG/CAIQ ids and redaction notes)
- kms-operator-access-matrix.csv (role-based matrix; PII redacted)
- revocation-log-samples.csv (12-month sample) + README_revocation_redaction.txt (explains hashing and salt method: SHA256 + org salt token; sample mapping process for audit)
- signed-wrap-cer.pem (public cert)
- transport-logs/transport-excerpt-2027-12-15_to_2028-03-14.csv (masked IPs, envelope IDs preserved)
- emergency-rotation-playbook.pdf + ledger-proofs/redacted-ledger-extract-signed.txt (signed by role: SRE-OnCall-3; signing fingerprint: SHA256:AB:12:CD:34:EF:56)

Ben attached a small CSV index (clearpay_evidence_index.csv) summarizing which SIG questions each artifact satisfies. If you want the same bundle via SFTP, tell us the endpoint and we will push it there and provide checksums.

If you need any additional detail for mapping samples to specific audit trails (non-PII mapping guidance), Irene can provide a short technical note.

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: clearpay_evidence_index.csv (CSV, 42 KB); kms-operator-access-matrix.csv (CSV, 18 KB); revocation-log-samples.csv (CSV, 120 KB); signed-wrap-cer.pem (PEM, 3 KB)
